feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Ardent Industries Inc. is a manufacturing and metal fabrication company outside ForgeX's target segment of home-service contractors.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended as the company is outside ForgeX's service segment.

risks.description: Offering home-service contractor automation packages to a B2B precision machining and fabrication shop would misalign with their shop-floor ERP, CAD/CAM quoting, and industrial production workflows.

qualification.rationale: Ardent Industries Inc. is a precision sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining, powder coating, and welding manufacturer serving industrial clients (semiconductor, robotics, chemical processing, automotive aftermarket, etc.). It is outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led HVAC, plumbing, and electrical home-service contractors.
